Key takeaways

- MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets agents use external tools.

- GEO MCP servers do two jobs: AI visibility tracking and site GEO audits.

MCP is a standard way to connect AI agents to tools and data. A GEO MCP server exposes GEO tools — like “check whether ChatGPT mentions my brand for this prompt” or “score this page’s AI readiness” — so your agent can call them during a conversation. Instead of manually testing prompts in five AI engines, you ask your agent and it runs the checks for you.

Claude AI GEO is about one question: when someone asks Claude for the best option in your niche, does it name you? Claude increasingly answers with web search and cites its sources, which means the same principles that get you into Google’s AI answers work for Claude too. In the video below I show Claude-powered AI SEO in action. Here’s how to get cited by Claude, how to check your visibility, and what I’d do first.

Key takeaways

- Claude cites web sources when it searches — be one of them.

- Strong Google rankings and trusted mentions help Claude find you.

- Write answer-first, quotable pages built on real experience.

## How Claude decides who to recommend

When Claude answers with web search, it reads the pages that rank for the question and summarises what they say, citing them. If several good pages all name the same brand, Claude tends to repeat it — the same pattern I’ve seen in Google’s AI. Without search, it relies on what it learned in training, which reflects what was widely published about you. Either way, the brands that get recommended are the ones that are widely and consistently described as the answer.

- Rank in Google for your money questions — AI search often draws on top results.

- Answer in the first sentence so your page is easy to quote.

- Add tables and FAQs with short, direct answers.

- Build your entity — a clear About page, consistent bios and profiles.

- Earn mentions on sites Claude already trusts in your niche.

- Let AI crawlers in — check robots.txt allows ClaudeBot and similar crawlers on pages you want cited.

- Keep facts current — outdated pages get skipped.
